name: Napoleon
source:
The aristocrat who is married to Serenity's sister. He leaves his wife at home, and is often seen with other women. A shameless playboy, he even has the nerve to hit on Serenity! Napoleon is an investor in the galactic express project.
[From [url=https://teamotomegamejam.itch.io/the-algernon-affair]itch.io[/url]]
